title: Iran's Golestan Palace damaged by bombing | DW News
text:
Iran’s UNESCO-listed Golestan Palace was reportedly damaged in US-Israeli air strikes on central Tehran. Iranian media says windows, mirrors and doors were damaged by reverberations from nearby blasts. The former royal palace is one of Tehran’s oldest sites. UNESCO says sent coordinates of World Heritage List sites to warring parties.
